issues.description: Method toString(): the solution implementation defines the method as 'public Object toString()' (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java, line 64). The problem statement and Java's Object API expect toString() to return a String (problem_statement.md describes the required String output and example at lines 36-38). This discrepancy causes a compilation error (invalid override) and will confuse students about the correct return type for toString().
issues.suggestedFix: Change the method signature in the solution to 'public String toString()' (keeping the @Override annotation) and ensure the method returns a String formatted as specified in the problem statement (e.g. "Lecture{lectureName='...', numberOfInscribedStudents='...', ...}"). This restores a valid override of java.lang.Object.toString() and prevents compilation failure.
